title: Exelon Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results and Initiates 2026 Financial Outlook
summary: Earnings Release Highlights Executed Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings per share above expectations, with GAAP net income of $0.58 per share and Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings of $0.59 per share for the fourth quarter of 2025, resulting in full-year GAAP net income of $2.73 per share
